prompt: In chess, both players have made many moves in a row with no pawn move and no capture. Under the fifty-move rule, when can a player claim a draw?

options.text: After 25 full moves with no pawn move or capture
After 50 full moves by each player with no pawn move and no capture
Only when both players agree, whatever the count
Never — play must continue until checkmate or stalemate

explanation: Under the fifty-move rule, a player to move can claim a draw if the last 50 moves by each player were completed without a pawn move or a capture. At 75 such moves the draw is automatic.
